1d_within_drive_target_overlap.finding: No within-drive overlapping target horizons in any split.

validation_unverified_window_investigati.root_cause_explanation: Drive 2BJD03RD suffered an initial mechanical failure on 2025-04-09 (catalog-recorded in train). The drive re-appeared in Backblaze operational telemetry on 2025-10-24 and continued reporting until 2026-02-08, when Backblaze telemetry recorded an authentic SECOND failure event (failure == 1). Because census.py deduplicated failures by serial_number keeping the first occurrence, only 2025-04-09 was retained in failure_catalog.csv. Window target_start=2026-02-07, target_end=2026-02-08 is a genuine re-failure event in raw telemetry, NOT a false positive or preprocessing error.

1e_label_integrity.finding: Train (2,799/2,799) and Test (809/809) positives are 100% catalog-verified. Validation has 693/694 catalog-verified positives. The 1 remaining positive window (Drive 2BJD03RD, target 2026-02-07 to 2026-02-08) was traced to a genuine second failure event in raw daily telemetry following drive re-deployment, omitted from failure_catalog.csv due to first-occurrence deduplication. All 4,302 positive labels across splits are grounded in telemetry failures. Zero false negatives detected in negative windows.

1f_cross_split_input_history_overlap.finding: 66,899 (36.45%) val windows and 63,180 (35.69%) test windows have input history starting in the preceding calendar quarter. This is EXPECTED temporal fleet continuity, NOT future-feature leakage. Input matrix X contains only historical observations prior to target_start. No target information or future observations enter the input sequences.

1g_disappearing_drives.finding: Of the 323 drives that ceased reporting without an official failure flag, 303 (93.81%) showed normal SMART metrics on their final operational day, supporting routine decommission/migration. Exactly 20 drives (6.19%) exhibited elevated error metrics (> 2 std on reallocated/pending/uncorrectable sectors), representing potential proactive pre-emptive replacements. These 20 drives account for 744 training windows (0.0957%) and 79 validation windows (0.0430%). Crucially, ZERO suspect drives appear in the test split; test evaluation metrics are completely unaffected.

2b_vectorized_equivalence.finding: Vectorized sufficiency-count bootstrap is mathematically identical to row-index resampling (max diff = 0.00e+00).

Transformer.variance_structure_note: Cluster bootstrap resamples drive IDs with replacement, preserving within-drive temporal correlation. Here cluster CIs are slightly narrower than naive CIs (width ~0.043 vs ~0.050). This is statistically sound: cluster CIs can be narrower or wider depending on the balance of within-cluster versus between-cluster variance across rare failure events.

exclusion_classification.reason_1_train_val_boundary_isolation: 13,423 windows had 7-day target horizons straddling the 2025-12-31 / 2026-01-01 boundary (history_end in 2025-12-25..2025-12-30). Dropped to prevent training targets from drawing failure observations from 2026 validation.
exclusion_classification.reason_2_val_test_boundary_isolation: 12,627 windows had 7-day target horizons straddling the 2026-03-31 / 2026-04-01 boundary (history_end in 2026-03-25..2026-03-30). Dropped to prevent validation targets from drawing failure observations from 2026 Q2 test.
exclusion_classification.reason_3_intermittent_reporting_boundary: 132 windows belonged to drives with intermittent reporting gaps spanning boundaries.

check3_window_count_reconciliation.finding: Independently enumerated all 26,182 excluded windows from actual split metadata. The sum (26,182) exactly equals the difference between generated (1,164,052) and retained (1,137,870) windows. Classification confirms that 100% of exclusions were performed to enforce strict temporal target isolation across split boundaries (zero cross-split target leakage).
